_about: David Hay Fleming (1849-1931), historian of the Scottish Reformation: The Reformation in Scotland, Causes, Characteristics, Consequences, the Stone Lectures at Princeton, 1907-1908 (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1910). Published in 1910, so public domain in the US; he died in 1931, so out of copyright in the UK since 2002. Also The Story of the Scottish Covenants in Outline (1904), from Project Gutenberg's transcription. His edition of Patrick Walker is on the patrick-walker shelf. The name check looks for 'Hay Fleming'. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
